title: Pago la pauta y no vendo: los leads que sí compraron, por fuera (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 13)

ia.dice: Cien mil pesos al mes en Facebook… trescientos leads para mis asesores inmobiliarios.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Night, the owner's office of a real estate agency, dark, lit only by the glow of a big computer monitor showing a Facebook Ads dashboard with charts and the word "LEADS". Don Ramiro, the owner of a real estate agency, a short chubby Mexican man in his fifties with a thick black mustache, receding hairline, white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a loose red tie, sits in front of the monitor, exhausted, loosened tie, looks at the screen and then at the camera with tired eyes and says in Mexican Spanish, tired and bitter, slow: "Cien mil pesos al mes en Facebook… trescientos leads para mis asesores inmobiliarios." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, quiet night office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Night, the owner's office of a real estate agency, dark, lit only by the glow of a big computer monitor showing a Facebook Ads dashboard with charts and the word "LEADS". Don Ramiro, the owner of a real estate agency, a short chubby Mexican man in his fifties with a thick black mustache, receding hairline, white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a loose red tie, rubs his face with both hands in desperation, then throws his arms up and looks at the camera and says in Mexican Spanish, desperate, almost shouting: "¿Y ventas? Cero. ¿Dónde están esos clientes?" Close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, quiet night office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Firme aquí, señora. Y tranquila: la inmobiliaria no tiene por qué enterarse.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, a coffee shop table with two coffee cups and a contract with a pen. Rodrigo, a tall thin Mexican real estate agent in his thirties with slicked-back shiny hair, a thin pencil mustache, a shiny grey suit with an open collar and a gold chain, sly smile, sits at the table sliding a contract and a pen to a smiling client off-screen, then winks at the camera and says in Mexican Spanish, sweet and overly friendly, the last words whispered: "Firme aquí, señora. Y tranquila: la inmobiliaria no tiene por qué enterarse." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, coffee shop ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Pagas la pauta y los leads sí llegan. Pero si tus asesores los atienden en su WhatsApp personal, algunas de esas ventas se cierran por fuera.
Lead Master se conecta al WhatsApp y a las llamadas de tus asesores y vendedores, y en automático te dice qué pasó con cada lead. Todos los días te llega el reporte, sin que nadie llene nada.
